title: October 4th First Call
speaker: Chris Vecchio and Ilya Spivak

macro_themes.theme: Bessent backs off the bond market
macro_themes.view: Bessent 'tapping out' may be a sentiment turning point, like the post-Liberation Day pause showing a reaction function.
Fed hike odds have retreated after a weak jobs report, but the long end stays high, driven mostly by real yields (hot economy, AI capex, deficits).
GBP, EUR and AUD sit at range support; if the bond market is done, an anti-dollar trade favours emerging markets.
VIX term-structure signal and midterm-year seasonality point to further equity gains over the next 3 months.
Bombers leaving England hints the Iran war may wind down before the midterms, easing oil and inflation.

calls.reason: VIX/3-month VIX spread signal historically leads to ~11% average 3-month gains with 93% hit rate; past the scary part of seasonality in a midterm year.
calls.quote: volatility unfolding right now in a manner that's consistent with stocks continuing to have some bull run

calls.reason: Long the debasement trade since August; Bitcoin held up better than gold and silver.
calls.quote: We knew that in August, which is why we got long Bitcoin, gold, the debasement trade... Bitcoin still holding up here

calls.reason: Breakout in real time; keeps wheeling shares long from 615 and treats it as a run back at the high.
calls.quote: There's no there's no reason to to treat this as anything other than opening the door for a run back at the high.

calls.reason: Months of consolidation then a breakout that paused above former highs; rolled the bullish position out 33 days.
calls.quote: Marll here is extending to the upside.

calls.reason: Brazil election first round favours the market-friendly candidate; weekly chart looks good and a softer dollar would help EM.
calls.quote: I've been long basically going on two years now and just rolling and adding and rolling and adding.

calls.instrument_quoted: crude oil futures options (short call spread / iron condor)
calls.reason: Holds short call spreads on oil; expects the war to shift to an economic squeeze so crude isn't running away.
calls.quote: I'm sitting with a slight short bias right now I suppose here because I do have a short call spread on.

calls.instrument_quoted: GBP, EUR, AUD vs USD (daily charts)
calls.condition: If the bond market is about done and rate expectations keep falling.
calls.reason: Pound, euro and Aussie sit on multi-month support and are attempting to turn.
calls.quote: you look across the board here and there may be an interesting anti-doll opportunity.

calls.condition: Yields ease if Bessent backs off, oil eases and tariffs are not reinstated; otherwise real-yield pressure persists.
calls.reason: Hike odds fell after weak data but the long end stayed high on real yields; asks whether the bond market is 'about done'.
calls.quote: the story suddenly seems to be wait a second do we actually need all these rate hikes but the long end remains let us say …
